claims.text: The record's identifying facts are located: 'Magnesium Sulfate in Water for Injection' (recalling firm: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, LLC) is the subject of an FDA drug enforcement (recall) record, recall_number D-0478-2026.
The identifying facts are established (C1) AND the record's own classification field has been located and is recognized as Class I (FDA's most severe recall classification).

C2 holds AND the record's own voluntary_mandated field confirms the recall was voluntary (firm-initiated), not FDA-mandated, AND the record's own reason_for_recall field names a product mix up issue AND the record's own report_date postdates 2020-01-01: the record supports a verdict of a recent (reported after 2020-01-01), voluntary, Class I recall due to a product mix up issue.

atoms.proposition: The record's identifying fact (product_description) is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='product_description') and found present.

The record's classification is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='classification') and found to equal 'Class I' (FDA's most severe recall classification: reasonable probability that use of, or exposure to, the violative product will cause serious adverse health consequences or death).
The record's voluntary_mandated field is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='voluntary_mandated') and found to equal 'Voluntary: Firm initiated'.
The record's reason_for_recall field is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='reason_for_recall') and found to contain the substring 'Product mix up'.

The record's report_date_iso field is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='report_date_iso') and found to be strictly after 2020-01-01 (real report_date reformatted YYYYMMDD->YYYY-MM-DD; see notes_for_annotators).

Non-route background: the record's status field is read via inspect_record(record_id='D-0478-2026', field_path='status') and found to be one of the recognized values {Ongoing, Completed, Terminated} (not required for, and not evidence toward, the Class-I/voluntary/reason/date verdict).
